body:
**What breaks:** under the nextest `mutants` profile a root test is killed at 15 s (5 s × 3), 5 s above `CONFIRM_WINDOW_FALLBACK`; a harness test (`package(viola-e2e)`) at 30 s. A test that waits out a designed floor (verify's waits of the gate's 8.5 s maximum, about 43 s; the product's 10 s confirmation window or a send under a held paste hint, 8.7–9.9 s, within a few seconds of the kill under host load) passes under profile `ci` and can be killed there, and a mutation run then ends before any mutant is graded. The first matching override wins, so a class override listed after a broader filter that also matches the test never applies.
**How to avoid:** a test that waits out a designed floor carries `send_window_`, `send_under_the_paste_hint_` or `verify_window_` in its name (30 s, 30 s and 80 s under `mutants`), the fake agent dialog and framing replay tests over every recorded set take the `verify_window_` kill too (the override names them, in both the `ci` and `mutants` profiles), and the `verify_window_` override stands ahead of `package(viola-e2e)`; `tests/contract_lints.rs` pins that order. Size any other new root case against the 15 s kill, not CI's 20 s.
**Fix if broken:** measure the floor first; rename the test into its class. A kill line moves only for a floor that is by design, with a planted-hang control, both readings recorded.
**References:** test-plan §3 Bootstrap phases `test-runner-install`, §10 Mutation gate; `.config/nextest.toml`; `.claude/rules/testing.md` 2026-09-24 (extended 2026-10-06), 2026-09-28 (extended 2026-10-05); chunk 2026-10-09-epoch-3-cleanup `evidence/e2e-floor.md`, `evidence/planted-hang.md`.

- Readiness is a file-state probe polled every 100 ms against a deadline of 20 s per instance after the build, staged: first `diagnostics/run-<name>.ndjson` has `process-start` for `subject:"self"` and `subject:"claude-child"`, both pids alive by pid + start time (missing `<name>:run-process-start` / `<name>:child-process-start`; a `process-exit` for `subject:"self"` first is `run-exited`); then the snapshot has `pid/started_at/child_pid/endpoint` and the heartbeat is < 5 s (missing `<name>:snapshot` / `<name>:endpoint` / `<name>:heartbeat`); then `events.ndjson` lines 1 and 2 = `wheel{cause:start}` → `session-start{source:hook}` (`start_records`, missing `<name>:events`; `supervise` passes `--fixtures <root>/fixtures/claude`). Failure reasons are the closed list in test-plan §3 (`build-failed`, `verify-failed`, `run-exited`, `readiness-timeout`). After a failed readiness the boot waits at most `ABORT_DEADLINE` for its abort, so a stuck boot ends strictly below the `ci` per-test kill of `binary(harness_lifecycle)`; the per-instance readiness bound `INSTANCE_DEADLINE` stays.

- 2026-09-24: A test wait that a mutant can reach must detect the watched process's exit (`try_wait`) and be bounded below cargo-mutants' 20 s auto-timeout floor, and so must the nextest mutants kill. Otherwise a mutant that makes the process exit silently spins to the bound and is graded Timeout instead of caught, depending on which tests the runner happens to schedule first. Extended 2026-09-27: a test's own assertion deadline must also sit below the nextest profile's kill line, or the kill preempts the test and its failure dump is lost. Extended 2026-09-27: a deadline EQUAL to the kill line is a race the test can lose — keep it strictly below, and have a spawned child stream its report to a known file outside the test's tempdir, so a runner kill still leaves the evidence. Extended 2026-10-06: a root test with no `send_window_` / `verify_window_` prefix, and not one the `verify_window_` override names (the fake agent's dialog and framing replay tests), runs under the `mutants` profile's 15 s kill, tighter than its 20 s CI kill, so size a new stamped-home case (the stamp alone is about 4 s) against the smaller one. [corrected 2026-11-15: the `mutants` default kill is 15 s (5 s × 3), the shared `WITHIN` 12 s, since chunk 2026-11-15-mutation-and-coverage-baselines-green] [corrected 2026-11-22: the `verify_window_` override also names the two fake-agent replay tests, since chunk 2026-11-22-epoch-4-cleanup]

- 2026-11-22: A rename of a product constant or a move of a nextest filter is swept over the test tree's string literals too, not only its code: `tests/contract_bounded_readers.rs`' census needles spell a product call's arguments verbatim and `tests/contract_lints.rs` pins an override's whole filter line, so both read red until re-pointed.

The session mended the Epoch 4 audit's ranked defects and re-measured the chrono advisory; no capability was claimed and no row flips.
A send whose claimed session-start line fails its snapshot write now settles back to waiting and ends unconfirmed through the existing confirm deadline, answering not-delivered with no-prompt-submitted; no new closed word and no new time bound.
The claude agents read now has its own named kill bound at the same 5 s the version probe uses, not measured against the real CLI; the stalled-host false red of verify's agents read is not mended and stays a carry.
The test harness's abort wait after a failed readiness moved from 20 s to 15 s, a test-only bound; the readiness bound stays 20 s.
Two drift replay tests joined the verify-window kill class in both the ci and mutants nextest profiles, no kill value moved; eight killable mutation survivors got killing cases and two equivalents were named.

body:
The session mended the Epoch 4 audit's ranked defects and re-measured the chrono advisory; no capability was claimed and coverage stays 23/37.
In the send path, a session-start line the confirm window claimed whose snapshot write then fails now settles the slot unclaimed, so the send goes back to waiting and the confirm window's existing deadline closes it as send-refused with detail no-prompt-submitted. Before, the error returned with the slot still claimed.
The claude agents --json read now has its own named kill bound, AGENTS_READ_DEADLINE, at 5 s, the version probe's value kept and not measured against the real CLI. The version probe keeps VERSION_DEADLINE, and verify's false red on the agents read under a stalled host stays an open carry.
The harness's abort wait after a failed readiness went from 20 s to 15 s, and the readiness deadline stays 20 s. Two drift replay tests joined the verify_window_ kill class in both the ci and mutants test profiles.
Tests were added for eight mutation survivors (env-names fault checks, the stamps document shape, screen option rows, the PTY pump's drain, enqueue and writer end), each shown red with its mutant applied. Two equivalent survivors are named and argued.
RUSTSEC-2026-0543 was re-read with no safe upgrade, so the ignore stands. A SIGKILLed verify was measured to leave one projects trust entry for its own temp folder. No new log line, event, detail word or span was added.

decision/test-layer-filtersets, decision/mutants-kill-below-cargo-mutants-timeout, decision/verify-driven-tests-20s-kill and decision/send-window-paste-hint-30s-kill: a nextest kill override's filter widened; their kill values unmoved — read only whether a row lists the class members.

decision/stamps-refuse-widened-ledger, decision/stamps-written-only-by-verify and decision/version-gate-needs-all-relied-rows: a new case refuses a v1 attempted stamp document of a failing shape; the relied-row count stays 29.

contract/claude-fixtures/env-names: new cases read the user word as an env name part, a user word inside a part as no part, and no user word as nothing.
decision/time-as-argument and decision/within-7s-wait-bound: the pump enqueue now has a case that waits for room until its deadline (indirect, over the pump's waits).

body_fields.fact: The claude agents --json read is killed at its own bound AGENTS_READ_DEADLINE, 5 s, separate from the version probe's VERSION_DEADLINE; the value is the version probe's, kept, not measured against the real CLI's agents read.

A session-start the send confirmation claimed whose snapshot write fails settles the send empty; the confirmation deadline then ends it not-delivered / no-prompt-submitted, never confirmed and never hung.
The harness abort wait after a failed readiness is 15 s, so a stuck boot ends within 17 s, below the 20 s ci kill of the harness lifecycle binary; the readiness bound stays 20 s.

run and revive start refusals, exit codes and preflight order, strict-modes and socket-directory checks: no start or refusal path changed.
